import torch, ctypes, b200probe as bp
from cuda.bindings import driver as d
src = open("/tmp/k.cu").read().replace("-3, h0 - 3", "-4, h0 - 3")
k = bp.cuda_kernel(src, "stage_tma")
class TM(ctypes.Structure): _fields_=[("v", ctypes.c_uint64*16)]
def launch(grid, thr, smem, tmop, *args):
    objs = [tmop] + [ctypes.c_void_p(a.data_ptr()) if isinstance(a, torch.Tensor) else ctypes.c_int32(a) for a in args]
    arr = (ctypes.c_void_p*len(objs))(*[ctypes.addressof(o) for o in objs])
    r = d.cuLaunchKernel(k.fn, grid,1,1, thr,1,1, smem, d.CUstream(torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream), ctypes.addressof(arr), 0)
    assert int(r[0]) == 0, r
u64 = lambda l: [d.cuuint64_t(v) for v in l]; u32 = lambda l: [d.cuuint32_t(v) for v in l]
def tmap_for(x, B, C, H, W, Wbox, RT, CS):
    err, tm = d.cuTensorMapEncodeTiled(d.CUtensorMapDataType.CU_TENSOR_MAP_DATA_TYPE_FLOAT32, 3, x.data_ptr(),
        u64([W, H, B*C]), u64([W*4, H*W*4]), u32([Wbox, RT+6, CS]), u32([1,1,1]), d.CUtensorMapInterleave.CU_TENSOR_MAP_INTERLEAVE_NONE, d.CUtensorMapSwizzle.CU_TENSOR_MAP_SWIZZLE_NONE,
        d.CUtensorMapL2promotion.CU_TENSOR_MAP_L2_PROMOTION_L2_128B, d.CUtensorMapFloatOOBfill.CU_TENSOR_MAP_FLOAT_OOB_FILL_NONE)
    assert int(err) == 0, err
    o = TM()
    for i,v in enumerate(tm.opaque): o.v[i] = int(v)
    return o
def run(B,C,H,W,RT,CS,CG,STG,thr=128, check=False):
    x = torch.randn(B,C,H,W,device="cuda")
    Wbox = W+8
    tm = tmap_for(x,B,C,H,W,Wbox,RT,CS)
    stf = Wbox*(RT+6)*CS; nTH=(H+RT-1)//RT; nGrp=C//CG
    grid = B*nTH*nGrp; smem = STG*stf*4+128
    k.set_smem(smem)
    out = torch.zeros(max(stf,16), device="cuda")
    if check:
        blk = grid-1
        launch(grid,thr,smem,tm,out,C,RT,nTH,nGrp,CG,CS,stf,STG,blk+1); torch.cuda.synchronize()
        g = blk % nGrp; t = blk//nGrp; th = t % nTH; b = t//nTH
        xp = torch.nn.functional.pad(x,(4,Wbox,3,RT+6))
        ref = xp[b, g*CG:g*CG+CS, th*RT:th*RT+RT+6, :Wbox]
        print("check", (out[:stf].view(CS,RT+6,Wbox)-ref).abs().max().item())
    f = lambda: launch(grid,thr,smem,tm,out,C,RT,nTH,nGrp,CG,CS,stf,STG,0)
    us = bp.harness_time(f)
    staged = grid*(CG//CS)*stf*4
    print(f"{B},{C},{H},{W} RT{RT} CS{CS} CG{CG} STG{STG} grid{grid} smem{smem//1024}K: {us:.1f} us, staged {staged/1e6:.1f} MB, {staged/us/1e3/148:.1f} GB/s/SM, x {x.numel()*4/us/1e6:.2f} TB/s")

u64 = lambda l: [d.cuuint64_t(v) for v in l]; u32 = lambda l: [d.cuuint32_t(v) for v in l]
